text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D and E after gains felt rewarding, but realizing a profit by itself is not a sound reason to sell; I should consider each stock’s expected role and the portfolio as a whole.","My reluctance to admit a mistaken purchase can make me cling to losing positions. I should assess them without anchoring on average cost, while respecting my risk limits.","After months of modest fluctuations and few trades, I should not infer patterns from random price moves. I can remain patient and trade only when my investment plan or circumstances justify it."]}
